mostWorthwhile.text: The insulin response was most worthwhile because it connected a meal to muscle glucose uptake, liver storage and a decreasing stimulus for insulin release.

leastWorthwhile.text: The separate transitions showing hormones traveling to their target organs felt repetitive; their effects came in the following steps.

surprise.text: The paired explanations of insulin and glucagon clarified that each response reduces the stimulus that prompted it.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, but every step offered only one combination, so I was following a prescribed sequence rather than making meaningful choices.

continue.text: I would be unlikely to continue personally: the biology is clearly connected, but the predictable, single-option sequence gives me little to decide.
